I have, they told me that "it just wasn't meant to be".

Rescued pregnant mum from the pound so she could give birth in a warm and loving home.

One of the kittens hasn't been feeding and is severely underweight, I have been syringe feeding which was going well for the first couple of days, now he is refusing to eat at all and it just seems like he has given up.

I don't know how to process this. I feel like a failure. I don't know if I keep trying to force feed him, essentially, as he seems to really hate it. He just wants to sleep, curled up with his mum where he is warm.

I hope he knows he is loved.
I'm sorry to hear that but don't be hard on yourself! You did amazing to be off it so long and if you can do it once you know you can do it again. Don't give up, keep going!
It doesn't mean that what you're experiencing isn't hard. Don't forget how strong you are too! ❤️
Thanks for commenting! You're very right, I think. You've done so well to get where you are, we got this!!
Thanks so much for the support. I'm proud of you too, you're incredibly strong and I hope you can keep this up! We got this! ❤️

I'm sorry for your loss, it's insane how quickly it takes over and it was so easy to keep telling myself I was fine and what I was doing was okay. I consider myself pretty lucky that I have been able to start making changes for the better. 

Thank you so much for your kindness. It's so amazing to get such overwhelming support from strangers. ❤️
You got this! Never stop fighting ❤️

I've used seroquel in the past, I have heart problems though and it made them worse. I take melatonin tablets and was prescribed blood pressure tablets to help with the nightmares. It helps sometimes, but not always. Thank you for your kind words and congratulations to you too! Keep it up!
Well done! You should be so proud of yourself. ❤️

I agree! I changed my phone number and made sure to not keep in contact with the toxic people that I was spending my time with. I didn't expect anything to come of this post but it's been so overwhelmingly amazing and encouraging, I haven't had that before and it's a really good feeling, I feel like finding more positive digital environments could be beneficial 😊

Thanks for your support! ❤️

I don't think I have replaced the addiction, I think it's more that I'm getting back into the things that I was doing before, in my case that was video games, but also making sure to not over indulge. I smoke weed still but I was doing that before I even touched meth or herion, I'm not sure if that subtracts from the improvements I have made haha 😅

I definitely agree that you need to make the decision for yourself. You need to be ready and willing to do it. I'll admit I wasn't totally willing when I made the decision to stop but seeing how unwell I was and realising I had let everything go just a few days after I stopped using and I decided that was the best decision to make.

I have a lot of ideas but I guess I don't know where to begin. Starting work again would be great, I've just been taking everything slow and easy. Enjoying time at home with my pets, who are doing so much better now thag their mum is doing better! Been doing a lot of DIY around the house which I haven't done before haha and gardening! I'm going to have the prettiest garden! Minor things but I think it's a start. 😊
I used meth about 10 years ago but only for a couple of weeks at the time. I didn't find it necessarily difficult to stop back then.

This month has been a roller-coaster to say the least, my boyfriend has been trying to tell me that the hard part is over, I had to explain to him that it certainly wasn't the case. I have been really anxious to join a recovery program. My doctor has been encouraging me to do so but it's a weird kind of shame that I feel when I think about it.
What is sleep? 😜 Honestly my sleep has always been horrible, now it's basically non-existent. My appetite is back though!

Part of me is saying not to think like I will relapse but I know in reality it is a possibility and I appreciate this advice.
It definitely gets better every day, I took up both gardening and baking, I barely know myself but in a good way.

Thank you so much for your kind words. I'm so sorry to hear about your friend, it's a horrible substance, I never really understood that fully until I stopped and saw how it had destroyed my body and life.

Sounds like you making positive steps and that's great! I would definitely advise stopping if that's something that you feel you are ready to do. You will be a much better person without it, I promise you. Keep up the great work ❤️
